claims.title: Actual pointwise input

claims.title: Ordinary strong witness existence
claims.statement: Approximate that lower test using Lemma6.4 ordinary global unit tests; choose error relative to its correlation and retain the finite coefficient sum. Some component remains correlated.

claims.statement: Build one ordinary sequence T_M with finite model/character/dimension tags, bounded tests and reciprocal threshold, all compatible unbounded Taylor coefficients, and finite coordinate choices. Natural extension supplies A.10 data.

claims.title: Internal relation and strong transfer
claims.statement: Encode finite correlation against reciprocal threshold in an internal relation; unit norm and equivariance transfer from the ordinary parameter class to all limit points and top-group elements.

claims.title: Uniform stage and internal witness map
claims.statement: Pointwise existence in a standard stage gives one standard complexity and threshold stage, followed by internal choice. Orbit coefficients remain unrestricted.

claims.title: Corrected bounded-stage proof
claims.statement: Nested finite-intersection representatives and ultrafilter-large sets construct a point in every bad set if no uniform stage exists, contradicting pointwise standard boundedness. No bare x_vv diagonal is used.

claims.statement: Zero padding retains full unit vectors; finite pigeonhole fixes coordinate/convention on a positive-density internal subset. Outside use constant unit representatives and a separate indicator.
